question: Choose the antonym of 'Lax'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lax"** means not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful; lacking attention or diligence. (असंयमी)

 
 
• **Example: **The security measures at the airport were lax, leading to safety concerns.
 
 
 
• **"Reliable" **refers to someone or something that can be trusted or depended upon; it is the opposite of being lax as it implies diligence and responsibility. (विश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **He is a reliable employee who always completes his work on time with accuracy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Lax'** is **'Reliable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reliable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stack** (ढेर): A pile or accumulation of objects, typically organized in a neat way.

 
 
• **Example:** There was a stack of books on the desk waiting to be read.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Showing lack of attention or thought; negligent.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless handling of the documents led to their damage.
 
 
 
• **Loose** (ढीला): Not tightly fixed or held; free or detached.
 
 
• **Example:** The screw was loose, causing the chair to wobble.
